name: Kotomiya Chinatsu
source:
A transfer student who enrolled at the academy on the same day as the protagonist.

With a gentle smile, she exudes a refined and soft aura, and her bright demeanor toward everyone from day one quickly earns her the title of the academy’s princess.

Chinatsu is always surrounded by a crowd, making it impossible to talk to her alone, but a chance encounter leads to working the same part-time job together.

“W-Would someone like me really be okay? I’m kind of a hopeless girl, you know?”
